description: After a failed attempt: retry again or give up, how long to wait, and whether the engine is refreshed. op retry: text, retriesUsed (automatic retries already scheduled), crashed (the engine process died, so there is only exception text). expected is null (no retry) or {retry, delayMs, engineRelated, rateLimited, refreshEngine}. At most 3 retries. The desktop keeps the full budget for an unrecognised failure (its engine updates daily); Android gives it one engine refresh and one retry.
